verdict_word: Penny beat on EPS, dividend up 8.8%
takeaways: Adjusted diluted EPS of C$2.31 edged the C$2.30 LSEG I/B/E/S estimate; reported diluted EPS jumped 30.2% to C$2.24.
Revenue grew 3.3% to C$4.15 billion, or 2.5% in constant currency.
Adjusted EBIT rose 1.6% to C$678.0 million, with the margin slipping 20 basis points to 16.4%.
Bookings were C$4.53 billion (109.2% book-to-bill); managed-services book-to-bill was 122%, which the CEO tied to AI-embedded services.
Full-year backlog stands at C$32.07 billion, about 1.9 times annual revenue, and the dividend rises 8.8%.
verdict: CGI is the Canadian IT consultant that never surprises anyone, and it didn't start today: a one-cent beat, 2.5% real growth and a fatter dividend. Boring is the product.
